papers.title: Rider's pass
lines: Practice: Monday, 5.30. Hot tea in the pits. Race: Saturday. Do not wave at the crowd, wave at the road.
Under it, in pencil: 'My father rode this. I'll ride it too. Don't tell Mum.'

papers.title: Smokehouse note
lines: Herring split, brined, hung in the oak smoke for sixteen hours.
The oak is from an old tree on the headland. The herring will not say how it feels about this.

papers.title: Cat show certificate
lines: Best Manx Cat in Show: no tail, plenty of attitude.
The judges wish it noted that the winner bit three of them.

trail.clue: A prize rosette was lost and buried near the lighthouse by a tail-less cat. Go and see.

papers.title: Tram timetable
lines: The horse tram runs every few minutes in summer, powered by one horse who has seen it all.
Fares: a penny to the end, tuppence to the end and back. Horse tips: carrots.
